2608.09551.title: Pragmatic Attack Surface: Vulnerabilities of Implicit Context in Large Language Models
2608.09551.paper_summary: In the era of large language models (LLMs), attackers often manipulate natural language to elicit unsafe or harmful outputs, creating a new natural language attack surface unique to LLM-based systems, where attacks directly exploit explicit linguistic cues in user prompts to bypass the safety mechanism of LLMs. However, such attacks can often be mitigated by existing safety alignment algorithms. On the other hand, human language is inherently grounded in pragmatics, necessitating typical context to interpret language, e.g., world knowledge, social norms. However, such contexts are often implicit because they are not directly expressed in human language and are not sufficiently leveraged in safety alignment, creating a fundamental mismatch between human language interpretation and safety alignment approaches. In this paper, we demonstrate that this mismatch exposes vulnerabilities in LLMs. We refer to this vulnerability as the pragmatic attack surface, which can be exploited to achieve high attack success rates. The experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms baseline attack methods across various open-source and closed-source models by a substantial margin.
2608.09551.paper_summary_zh: 在大型語言模型（LLMs）時代，攻擊者經常操縱自然語言以引發不安全或有害的輸出，創造了一個獨特於基於LLM系統的新自然語言攻擊面，其中攻擊直接利用用戶提示中的明確語言線索來繞過LLM的安全機制。 然而，這類攻擊通常可以通過現有的安全對齊算法來減輕。 另一方面，人類語言本質上根植於語用學，這需要典型的上下文來解釋語言，例如世界知識、社會規範。 然而，這些上下文往往是隱含的，因為它們並未在自然語言中直接表達，並且在安全對齊中未得到充分利用，造成了人類語言解釋與安全對齊方法之間的根本不匹配。 在本文中，我們展示了這種不匹配暴露了LLM的脆弱性。 我們將這種脆弱性稱為語用攻擊面，這可以被利用以實現高攻擊成功率。 實驗結果顯示，我們提出的方法在各種開源和閉源模型中顯著超越了基線攻擊方法。
